text:
rachel: Tiny but mighty shoutout — massive thanks to Tyrell and Facilities for jumping into the staging incident this AM. helped unblock a customer demo in <30m. you rock. :sparkles:

tyrell: thanks! grabbed an extra monitor from the stock room and re-routed staging traffic while Emma ran the smoke tests. teamwork ftw. :muscle:

emma: Tyrell did the heavy lifting on the wiring, Facilities cleaned up the wiring chaos, and Sahil kept the logs readable. cheers y'all. :beers: (reactions: :tada: x3)

sahil: the logs were sad but honest. glad the replay was clean. also shoutout to @facilities for the cordless drill rescue — who knew we'd need DIY at work today.

facilities: happy to help! minor note: we'll restock surge protectors and label the "spare monitors" shelf tomorrow. also hugs for the cookie stash that appeared in the kitchen :cookie:

rachel: who left the cookie stash? you are an angel. :pray:
sam: guilty as charged. saw the chocolate chip calling my name at 9:12 and thought of the team. :sunglasses:

emma: Sam = hero. filing a kudos to the team board now. kudosbot: Created kudos card for Tyrell, Facilities, Sahil, and Sam.

kudosbot: Summary: "Quick staging rescue + cookies — saved a customer demo. Extra props for fast triage and snack diplomacy." (kudos id: K-20260323-01)

lunchbot: Poll: "Thank-you pick-me-up for Facilities & Tyrell"  React: 1 Tasty sandwich platter, 2 Mini pastry box, 3 Savory snack boxes. Poll open 12h.

rychel: ok typo but vote goes to :two: for pastries.

sahil: :three: practical snacks please.

tyrell: :one: my team loves sandwiches.

emma: posting a quick slack note to the customer to say the demo went well and team helped out — tiny gestures, big impact. thanks again everyone.
